title: カイチョーとダジャレ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio and I are on our way back home from shopping, when…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't that Prez over there in the bookstore?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I wonder what book she's looking for? Knowing Prez, it must be something amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Like a manual on how to run even faster. Or how to be an emperor!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna buy whatever she buys!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I can say anything, she dashes off to greet Symboli Rudolf, who has just finished paying for her book.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, Teio. Fancy seeing you here.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, Prez, what book did ya buy? Tell me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh this? It's "Become the King of Puns! 100 of the Punniest Puns!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You didn't hear it? The punniest pu—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No, I heard you the first time! Wh-what a pick!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you're that interested in it, I'll lend it to you after I'm done. I'm sure it has much to teach you, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then, until next we meet.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Puns, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Puns, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: B-buy it? Y-yes! Of course! I'd never go back on my word!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Maybe puns are the key to getting stronger!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Time to study up on puns! Then, I'll be one step closer to becoming like Prez!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days later…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, Prez! You run fast as the wind, but does that ever make you winded?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm? I suppose so, but exertion is merely the evidence of how much one has labored.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Come on! I was making a pun! Wind and winded!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see. I understand now. However, I feel a better pun here would be…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's unexpectedly difficult to come up with a pun that will make Symboli Rudolf laugh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That said, I'm sure this experience will help Tokai Teio to grow in some way.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Buying a book on puns isn't really gonna help me become more like Prez.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, let's head back then! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It was surprising to see Rudolf go out of her way to buy a book about puns, but the incident soon fades from my memory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days later…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As students of the esteemed Tracen Academy, we must strive to do our utmost both on the track and in the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In doing so, we will be on track to achieving our goals.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wow, Prez is as cool as ever! She delivers such wonderful speeches! ♪
choice_data_list: Did she just slip a pun in there?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No way! There's no way she'd put a pun in such an amazing speech!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "We must strive to do our utmost both on the track and in the classroom. In doing so, we will be on track to achieving our goals."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Where's the pun in that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Wait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once she realizes, the shock renders Tokai Teio speechless for a while.
